page.overview:
Who is Joanna of Houtborg?

Joanna of Houtborg was the first wife of Vizimir I before he became the king of Redania.

Being the second son, it was unlikely Vizimir would ever hold the title of king, and thus he married Joanna. However, when the infamous Falka started her rebellion, she wiped out her entire side of the family, including Redania's current king and Vizimir's nephew, Vridank. This made Vizimir the next king, but the problem was Joanna was infertile and thus, couldn't conceive an heir. After Vizimir was formally made king, he was immediately divorced from Joanna over her infertility and married the younger Ramona Thyssen to continue the family line.
